facts.fact: Orange Tunisie inaugurated a new 1,000 m2 data centre at Kalaa Kebira, Sousse, serving its own needs and B2B customers with hosting, cloud and backup; the document gives no event date, so its published date 2025-05-06 is used.

Orange Tunisie states its new Kalaa Kebira, Sousse data centre has a technical environment conforming to the Tier III standard (operator statement, no certifier named); the document gives no event date, so its published date 2025-05-06 is used.
